pages.text: Energy pipes, the veins of your grid, come in 4 tiers: basic, intermediate, advanced, ultimate — transfer rates climb tier by tier.$(br)Building something big? Route your pipes right first, or the power will jam up worse than rush-hour traffic.

The Configurator is your pipe remote control:$(li)Right-click a pipe: toggle push/pull mode$(li)Sneak + right-click: break/restore one side of the connection$(br2)Wired it backwards? Don't panic, whip this out and save the day.
